finding: Online Financial Fraud is the most frequently reported crime category, accounting for 59.46% of all reports.
UPI Related Frauds is the most frequently reported crime subcategory, accounting for 25.52% of all reports.
The top five crime categories together represent 93.79% of the dataset, indicating a strong concentration of reported incidents within a small number of crime categories.
Crime reports contain an average of approximately 389 characters, while the median report length is 295 characters.

The analysis covers 81,073 cleaned crime reports across 15 crime categories. The dataset does not contain a dedicated date field, so the analysis identifies distributions and patterns rather than chronological crime trends.
